mechanism_narrative: In contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100), persistent under-supply conditions suppress growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A short-term surge in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reactions to economic momentum.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below 100 signals supply-side contraction, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in INDPRO <100 instances are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p >0.05), or IC >0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in GDPC1 (demand) and decline in INDPRO (supply) signals conflicting growth signals, but the demand-driven momentum outweighs supply constraints, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in such interactions are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p >0.05), or IC <0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In early recovery regimes, a sustained drop in UNRATE below 3.5% signals labor market normalization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
